_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Fear/VIX relief plus rising clean-asset intake and bottom analog favor one rung up the ladder into Denial, not a skip to Hope.
next_move.brains_agree: split — analyst wants Hope/UP; narrative silent on phase; consensus clips to Denial (+1) per ladder rule
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds above $85,000 with 30d momentum reversing above 0% and intake staying positive
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $75,000 with 30d momentum under -5% and renewed exchange outflows
